The Course

Lowcountry golf with a point of view.

BGC moves through mature live oaks, tall pines and lagoons, giving the round a sense of place that feels unmistakably Bluffton.

The Davis Love III layout balances playability with decision-making. Defined corridors and risk-reward choices invite golfers to pick a line, commit to it and think beyond simply hitting it as far as possible.

With six tee options and 6,692 yards from the Champion tees, the course can be approachable for a casual round and still provide a meaningful test for experienced players.

Why Play BGC

Playable, strategic and rooted in its setting.

BGC combines public access, a respected design pedigree and the natural character of the South Carolina Lowcountry in a course that rewards good decisions without demanding one style of play.

  • 18-hole Davis Love III design
  • Par 71 · 6,692 yards from the Champion tees
  • Six tee options
  • Live oaks, pines, lagoons and Lowcountry wetlands
Davis Love III & the Lowcountry

A Lowcountry legacy built on strategy.

Davis Love III’s connection to Lowcountry golf runs deeper than a name on a scorecard. He won at Harbour Town five times — in 1987, 1991, 1992, 1998 and 2003 — more than any player in RBC Heritage history.

Those wins came on a course that rewards patience, angles and committed shot-making. That history matters here because Love’s work as a designer follows a similar idea: golf should be interesting to look at, thoughtful to play and full of choices.

Five-time RBC Heritage Champion · 21-time PGA TOUR winner

From competing with purpose to designing with it.

Love Golf Design describes its approach as a blend of artistry, common-sense thinking and classic design strategy. At BGC, that philosophy is reflected in a course where risk and reward, natural framing and playable variety shape the experience.

The connection is especially fitting in Bluffton: a Davis Love III course only a short drive from the Hilton Head setting where he built one of the defining records of his career.

Choose Your Tees

Six tee options let the course fit your game.

From the 6,692-yard Champion (Gold) tees to the 4,897-yard Forward (Red) tees, BGC gives golfers room to choose a distance that keeps the round challenging, enjoyable and at the right pace.

FAQ

Quick answers before you play.

Is Bluffton Golf Club open to the public?

Yes. Bluffton Golf Club is a public golf course in Bluffton, South Carolina.

Who designed Bluffton Golf Club?

Bluffton Golf Club is an 18-hole Davis Love III design.

What is the par and yardage?

BGC is a par-71 course that plays 6,692 yards from the Champion (Gold) tees.

How many tee sets are available?

BGC offers six tee options so golfers can choose a distance that fits their game.

Does BGC have practice facilities?

Yes. Practice facilities include a driving range, pitching and chipping area, and putting green. Instruction is also available.

How do I book a tee time?

Use the Book a Tee Time button to open Bluffton Golf Club’s live booking page, or call (843) 757-5900 for assistance.
